summary.zh: 规划内容支柱、定位与发布节奏
summary.en: Plan LinkedIn pillars, positioning and posting cadence.

description.zh: 为一个账号或一个人制定 LinkedIn 内容规划：内容支柱、账号定位、能长期执行的发布节奏，以及是否值得开通讯栏目。适合不确定该发什么、多久发一次的时候使用。
description.en: Builds a LinkedIn content plan: pillars, positioning, a cadence you can actually keep and whether a newsletter is worth starting. Use it when you are unsure what to post about or how often.
